issues_found: Unsupported claim: 'Weak risk management in the $1+ trillion Treasury repo market' — the source does not provide a specific dollar figure for the repo market size
human_review_reason: One unsupported claim in why_it_matters (the $1+ trillion figure) needs correction, but the record is otherwise accurate and well-structured. This is a minor issue that can be auto-corrected.

corrected_fields.why_it_matters: Weak risk management in the Treasury repo market can pose systemic risks if major participants default. This guidance aims to standardize haircuts and margin practices across bilateral repo transactions, reducing leverage opacity and improving financial system stability during market stress. Market participants handling material repo exposures should begin evaluating their legal agreements and policies now to meet the June 2026 deadline.
corrected_fields.market_structure_context: This guidance directly addresses Treasury market plumbing by recommending standardized haircuts/margin for bilateral repo. It follows the 2022 TMPG white paper on clearing/settlement and a pilot data study by Treasury's Office of Financial Research on the non-centrally cleared bilateral repo market. The guidance complements SEC rule amendments expanding central clearing, which will cover some but not all repo volume.
